My dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939),
[The Clever Woman of the Family](/book/58) as far as she goes will be sent you in a day or two from a friend who had had her to read.

The [illustrations](/topic/167) are decidedly not successful and I should not wish to perpetuate them.

They are not half so good as what [Miss Keary](/person/793)’s young [cousin](/person/887) does.[^1]
There is about a fourth more of the story to come.
I have nearly finished the [Golden Deeds](/book/51), but alas the Lotty story has eluded me twice again.

However I have quite enough for the pages.

Yours very truly
C. M.

Yonge


[^1]: Katie Johns, who was related to the novelist Annie Keary (1825-1879).
